title: Attended Appointments Without a Billed Visit and the Insured Plan of Care Visit Limit
content:
For the Insured Plan of Care visit limit, appointments attended on the plan's active Appointment Series without a billed visit count against the visit limit only through a retroactive request. They are the attended appointments on the active series in excess of the treatment, progress report and re-evaluation visits billed on the plan, never fewer than zero.

| Retroactive requests and approvals on the plan | Counted against the limit for those appointments |
|---|---|
| Retroactive requests ask for more visits than retroactive approvals have granted | The visits asked for less the visits granted, in their place |
| Every visit asked for retroactively has been granted | None of them is added; the granted visits count once they are billed |
| No retroactive request has been made | Every such appointment |

## Questions and answers (hypothetical)

**20 appointments attended on the active series, 16 treatment, progress report and re-evaluation visits billed, no retroactive request. What counts?** The 4 unbilled appointments.

**Same plan; a retroactive request asked for 6 visits and nothing has been granted yet. What counts?** 6, the visits asked for less the 0 granted.

**A retroactive request asked for 6 and an approval granted 6. What counts?** Nothing is added for the unbilled appointments; the 6 granted visits count once they are billed.

**A retroactive request asked for 6 and an approval granted 4. What counts?** 2.
